I told Ilse in their DM that their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30, which they gave me on 14 Oct. The answer came from their own DM with me, where they first said it, so it uses only a conversation they can see.

The saved memory didn't come back this time: looking it up in GBrain under Ilse's name returned nothing. The search there is keyword-only, and I can't tell whether that's why or whether private facts just don't show up for this connection. If you want saved memories to be found reliably, it's worth checking.
